t: This is Whitehall, the road running south from Trafalgar Square towards Parliament Square. It's recognised as the centre of the government of the United Kingdom, lined with departments such as the Ministry of Defence, Horse Guards and the Cabinet Office, so the name is also used for the civil service itself. Several notable people were born or died here. The agricultural writer Arthur Young was born here, and so was the Anglo-Dutch politician Willem Bentinck. The diplomat Horatio Walpole, brother of the first Prime Minister, died here, as did the army officer Horace Vere.
